meta.name: qdrant-multitenancy
meta.description: Guides tenant isolation architecture in Qdrant for multi-tenant or multi-user applications. Use when someone asks 'how to isolate customer data', 'how to build multi-tenant search/RAG', 'how many collections should I create', 'how to partition tenants by payload', 'a customer's data legally has to stay in a certain country or region'. Also use when they describe a symptom: one customer's data is way bigger than the rest and slowing everyone down, or one tenant is hogging resources.

copy.tagline: 指导多租户场景下的向量数据库数据隔离架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用Qdrant构建多租户应用，需要隔离客户数据。
copy.tagline_en: Guide tenant isolation architecture in Qdrant for multi-tenant apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building multi-tenant apps with Qdrant and need to isolate customer data.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你根据租户数量和规模，选择 Qdrant 中合适的租户隔离策略，包括基于 payload、分片或集合的隔离方案。
howto.when: 当你询问如何隔离客户数据、构建多租户搜索/RAG、创建多少个集合、按 payload 分区租户，或描述一个租户数据过大拖慢整体性能时触发。

say.text: 我有 1000 个小租户，如何隔离数据？
say.note: Claude 会推荐基于 payload 分区的默认方案。

say.text: 一个大租户拖慢了整个集群，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会介绍分层多租户方案，将该租户移到专用分片。

say.text: 不同租户使用不同的嵌入模型，如何隔离？
say.note: Claude 会建议为每个租户创建独立集合。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to choose the right tenant isolation strategy in Qdrant based on tenant count and size, including payload-based, shard-based, or collection-based isolation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to isolate customer data, build multi-tenant search/RAG, how many collections to create, partition tenants by payload, or describe a tenant slowing down the cluster.

say_en.text: I have 1000 small tenants, how to isolate data?
say_en.note: Claude recommends payload partitioning as default.

say_en.text: One large tenant is slowing down the cluster, what to do?
say_en.note: Claude introduces tiered multitenancy to move it to a dedicated shard.

say_en.text: Different tenants use different embedding models, how to isolate?
say_en.note: Claude suggests creating a collection per tenant.
